The '''6th Critics' Choice Awards''' were presented on January 22, 2001, honoring the finest achievements of [[2000 in film|2000 filmmaking]].<ref>{{cite web|last1=Armstrong|first1=Mark|title=Broadcast Critics Eat Crowe|url=http://uk.eonline.com/news/40898/broadcast-critics-eat-crowe|publisher=E! Online UK|access-date=9 September 2014|date=19 December 2000}}</ref>

==Top 11 films==
(in alphabetical order)
*''[[Almost Famous]]''
*''[[Billy Elliot]]''
*''[[Cast Away]]''
*''[[Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon|Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon (Wo hu cang long)]]''
*''[[Erin Brockovich (film)|Erin Brockovich]]''
*''[[Gladiator (2000 film)|Gladiator]]''
*''[[Quills (film)|Quills]]''
*''[[Thirteen Days (film)|Thirteen Days]]''
*''[[Traffic (2000 film)|Traffic]]''
*''[[Wonder Boys (film)|Wonder Boys]]''
*''[[You Can Count on Me]]''

[[File:Joaquin Phoenix at the 2018 Berlin Film Festival.jpg|thumb|right|150px|[[Joaquin Phoenix]], Best Supporting Actor winner]]

*'''Best Actor:'''
**[[Russell Crowe]] – ''[[Gladiator (2000 film)|Gladiator]]''
*'''Best Actress:'''
**[[Julia Roberts]] – ''[[Erin Brockovich (film)|Erin Brockovich]]''
*'''Best Animated Feature:'''
**''[[Chicken Run]]''
*'''Best Child Performance:'''
**[[Jamie Bell]] – ''[[Billy Elliot]]''
*'''Best Composer:'''
**[[Hans Zimmer]] – ''[[Gladiator (2000 film)|Gladiator]]'' and ''[[The Road to El Dorado]]''
*'''Best Director:'''
**[[Steven Soderbergh]] – ''[[Erin Brockovich (film)|Erin Brockovich]]'' and ''[[Traffic (2000 film)|Traffic]]''
*'''Best Family Film:'''
**''[[My Dog Skip (film)|My Dog Skip]]''
*'''Best Foreign Language Film:'''
**''[[Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon|Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon (Wo hu cang long)]]'' • [[China]] / [[Hong Kong]]
*'''Best Picture:'''
**''[[Gladiator (2000 film)|Gladiator]]''
*'''Best Screenplay – Adapted:'''
**''[[Traffic (2000 film)|Traffic]]'' – [[Stephen Gaghan]]
*'''Best Screenplay – Original:'''
**''[[Almost Famous]]'' – [[Cameron Crowe]]
*'''Best Song:'''
**"[[My Funny Friend and Me]]" performed by [[Sting (musician)|Sting]] – ''[[The Emperor's New Groove]]''
*'''Best Supporting Actor:'''
**[[Joaquin Phoenix]] – ''[[Gladiator (2000 film)|Gladiator]]'' and ''[[Quills (film)|Quills]]''
*'''Best Supporting Actress:'''
**[[Frances McDormand]] – ''[[Almost Famous]]'' and ''[[Wonder Boys (film)|Wonder Boys]]''
*'''Best Inanimate Object:'''
**Wilson the Volleyball – ''[[Cast Away]]''
